g.text: V16 | Physical plant built from small blocks
18-velocity-coordinate PhysX plant. Physical contact force comes from the contact solver, not the controller QP prediction.
State-dependent M, J, g, c and N read the current Q, v; the outer state return is on page 1.
Actual USD joint damping is zero. d includes unmodeled joint friction. Contact forces can be distributed; J^T lambda is their generalized-force reduction.
